item.title: Kano Court Sentences Actress to Six Months for Naira Abuse
item.description: The Federal High Court in Kano, northwestern Nigeria, has sentenced Kannywood actress Saadatu Mohammed Inuwa, also known as Samha, to six months in prison for tampering with Nigeria’s national currency.
